events.title: Vitellius's army defeats Otho at Bedriacum
events.description: Troops loyal to Vitellius beat Emperor Otho's forces near Cremona in northern Italy. Otho took his own life two days later, but Vitellius himself fell before the year was out.
events.html: Troops loyal to Vitellius beat Emperor Otho's forces near Cremona in northern Italy. Otho took his own life two days later, but Vitellius himself fell before the year was out.

events.title: Warwick the Kingmaker is killed at the Battle of Barnet
events.description: Edward IV defeated the Lancastrian army in fog at Barnet, and Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, was killed in the rout. Victory at Tewkesbury weeks later secured Edward's throne.
events.html: Edward IV defeated the Lancastrian army in fog at Barnet, and Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, was killed in the rout. Victory at Tewkesbury weeks later secured Edward's throne.

events.title: Noah Webster registers his American Dictionary
events.description: Noah Webster's American Dictionary of the English Language, with some 70,000 entries, was published. It promoted American spellings such as 'color' and 'center'.

events.title: John Wilkes Booth shoots Lincoln at Ford's Theatre
events.description: Five days after Lee's surrender, the actor John Wilkes Booth shot President Lincoln during a play in Washington. Lincoln died the next morning, the first US president to be assassinated.
events.html: Five days after Lee's surrender, the actor John Wilkes Booth shot President Lincoln during a play in Washington. Lincoln died the next morning, the first US president to be assassinated.

events.title: Titanic strikes an iceberg in the North Atlantic
events.description: At 11.40 pm the liner struck an iceberg south of Newfoundland, opening several forward compartments to the sea. She sank less than three hours later, early on 15 April.
events.html: At 11.40 pm the liner struck an iceberg south of Newfoundland, opening several forward compartments to the sea. She sank less than three hours later, early on 15 April.

events.title: Second Spanish Republic is proclaimed
events.description: After republicans swept the cities in municipal elections, the Republic was declared and Alfonso XIII left Spain. The new democracy was overthrown by the civil war that began in 1936.
